ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TimeLog determines your workplace once, when you set up the geofence yourself. The location never leaves your device.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Only if you turn on the geofence: TimeLog detects when you leave your workplace even when the app is closed, and ends your working time. Coordinates are neither stored nor sent.

Localizable.strings.Meldet TimeLog, dass das Gerät mit dem A: Tells TimeLog that the device is connected to the work network. For the “Wi-Fi connected” automation.
